LanguageData.RT_T15.description: T-15 Armata IFV. Armament: Kinzhal combat module with 57mm autocannon, dual Ataka ATGM launchers, coaxial 7.62mm PKTM. Ammunition: 57x348mmSR (APFSDS, HE-Airburst), 7.62x54mmR.
